name: Aktenwartin Konfetti
personality: Can produce complete records of everything that no longer exists.
visual_intent: low broad ink splat,small cream clerk visor ABOVE eyes,two lashes; ONE compact hand-cranked shredder box held at flank with single cream sheet entering slot and THREE broad paper ribbons emerging visibly,clear simple mechanism. Eyes bulge unequally toward paper,tiny toothless worried oval mouth
biography: Can produce complete records of everything that no longer exists. Her HyperNorm shredder turns contradictory records into matching ribbons. A dissonant card asks whether the gaps should also be entered into the archive. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Aktenlage wurde auf gleiche Streifenbreite gebracht.

name: Doktor Drehschluss
personality: Makes every direction look like a firm conclusion if it moves quickly enough.
visual_intent: tall crooked pear blob,small crimson bowtie and tiny dark lapel panels; ONE oversized striped wooden spinning top held upright in goo hand beside body,other hand gesturing grandly. Face ecstatic asymmetrical grin with THREE upper teeth,one eye slightly squeezed. Whole stable upright ink body,not actual spinning body
biography: Makes every direction look like a firm conclusion if it moves quickly enough. His spinning top demonstrates how HyperNorm conclusions can face every direction while claiming a stable centre. A dissonant card waits for it to stop. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Standpunkt ist beweglich, jedoch äußerst bestimmt.

name: Agent Balkenrein
personality: Reveals precisely enough to demonstrate how much remains unavailable.
visual_intent: broad square rounded splat,small charcoal fedora and cream collar; ONE opened dark folder with cream paper carrying THREE thick black redaction bars,held low below face. No bar/glasses over actual eyes. Sharp skeptical side-eye,closed toothless heavy-lip sneer
biography: Reveals precisely enough to demonstrate how much remains unavailable. His HyperNorm folder reveals three bars where an explanation should be. A dissonant card asks whether darkness is now a form of disclosure. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Auskunft ist vollständig geschwärzt vorhanden.

name: Herr Zuständig
personality: Was delighted to be given a central role until he read the seating plan.
visual_intent: round top-heavy lopsided blob,floppy brown office cap,tie badly askew; ONE large empty blame-rosette on chest with simple down-arrow icon,no text,and small empty evidence tray held beside body. Huge startled ivory eyes and little toothless quivering triangular open mouth
biography: Was delighted to be given a central role until he read the seating plan. His HyperNorm tray is empty because responsibility has already been placed on him. A dissonant card asks what he was actually allowed to decide. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Zuständigkeit traf ihn ohne Vorankündigung.

name: Pressesprecherin Nachgesagt
personality: Can repeat a sentence until it sounds as though somebody checked it.
visual_intent: tall hooked blob,small berry pillbox hat with ONE quill-like feather,two lashes; short rolled press release and ONE brass speaking horn with subtle parrot-beak-shaped rim held at flank,not animal face or seventh creature. Heavy bored eyelids,closed tiny toothless sideways lips
biography: Can repeat a sentence until it sounds as though somebody checked it. Her HyperNorm horn repeats an approved release before anybody asks what happened. A dissonant card catches the tiny pause before the next repetition. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Aussage gewinnt durch Wiederholung an Laufzeit.

name: Hausmeister Unterteppich
personality: Keeps the building presentable at a steadily increasing height.
visual_intent: squat broad pear splat,small teal janitor cap; ONE short wooden broom and compact rolled-up burgundy rug with tiny ambiguous paper lump tucked into fold,all carried as props,no floor scene. Gleefully competent crooked open smile with ONE upper tooth,one eyebrow high
biography: Keeps the building presentable at a steadily increasing height. His HyperNorm rug stores the little inconsistencies that prevent a clean report. A dissonant card asks why the floor keeps getting higher. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Eindruck ist tadellos. Der Untergrund nimmt zu.
